title: Local advertisers who would not use black musicians
summary: Some local ad producers refused black singers and musicians because of uptown clients, though local accounts like Jack's beer and Blue Plate paid well.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

They just used to use an advertiser.
